dct_title_s: Preliminary satellite-derived impact assessment on health facilities, Arbaat Dam, Al Ganap Locality, Red Sea State, Sudan, 2 September 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240826SDN, GDACS ID: 1102854** Status: Affected structures detected Further action(s): continue monitoring Summary of findings: Water levels have been notably reduced in the Arbaat Dam observed as of 31 August 2024; Flooded areas and overflow evidence observed along the waterway in Alganab locality as of 30 and 31 August 2024; Abunqarah, Kdoweeb, Tobler, Edbye Family Health Units, as well as Tedrbai Family Health Centers, appear to be unaffected by floodwaters. Tedrbai, Hit Wasat, Tamli, Agoamet Srarah, and Tegilo Family Health Units, as well as Kelkoy and Mostehliland Shalhout Family Health Centers, are likely affected by floodwaters.
